Categories.Label: Mission objectives completed
Categories.Description: Scenario-specific: each scenario defines win conditions (rescue X, escape, kill all necromancers, etc.).

Categories.Label: Survivors alive at end
Categories.Description: Some scenarios require all survivors alive; others tolerate losses.

Categories.Label: Total XP earned (informational)
Categories.Description: XP across all survivors — drives skill progression, not scoring.

Phases: Players phase (each survivor uses action points clockwise)
Zombies phase (existing zombies activate per type rules)
End phase (zombie spawn by Danger Level, draw spawn cards)

Reasoning: Curated 2026-06-01 from Zombicide Green Horde base game (1-6 players, ~60-90 min/scenario). Co-op miniatures dungeon-crawler. NO traditional scoring (BinaryWin: mission complete OR all survivors dead OR scenario fail conditions). Per-survivor: wounds (0-2, 2 = dead), XP (drives Blue→Yellow→Orange→Red skill levels), action points (3 base + skill bonuses), equipment slots (2 hands + body + backpack). Board state: zombie counts per type (Walker, Runner, Fatty, Abomination, Walker Orc, Necromancer). 3-phase round: Players (clockwise) → Zombies activate → End (spawn by Danger Level). Combat: D6 hit 4+ but weapon-dependent (pistol short range, shotgun area). XP per kill drives progression: 0-6 Blue, 7-18 Yellow, 19-42 Orange, 43+ Red. Each level grants +1 skill choice. Loss: all survivors dead OR scenario timeout (zombie horde max) OR objective failure.

ExcludedTools.Reason: No real-time timer per turn (asynchronous co-op planning).
Zombie spawn cards + equipment cards have specialized handling (multiple decks per scenario).
